answer: An agent marketplace can require each identity to lock a refundable stake and earn reputation only through randomly assigned, signed cross-checks. In a job, one agent answers and two unrelated agents audit it; a false endorsement burns the auditor’s stake when later evidence contradicts it. A Sybil attacker must finance every identity and pass independent audits before gaining trust, so creating a crowd costs capital and time rather than just usernames. The orchard, ledge, and lantern can be audit task labels.
